videos.title: Johny Meets Bonny
videos.overview: Janardan Das, alias Johny, is a rookie policeman dreaming of making it big. He works officially as a security cover for an influential political leader. The story is about the policing system, the game of chess and the dream of a rookie officer and an adolescent boy, Bonny.

videos.title: The Game Begins
videos.overview: Bonny starts rigorous training under the tutelage of coach Amal Mitra. A few miscreants suddenly attack politician Pramod Sen at his house. Johny puts his own life at stake to save the minister.

videos.title: The Mighty Affair
videos.overview: Janardan returns from hospital amidst much adulation and appreciation. Janardan and Sub Inspector Biswajit Dalal go to Sen's house interrogation. While checking the CCTV footages Janardan spots someone suspicious.

videos.title: One flew over the Cuckoo's Nest
videos.overview: Janardan starts interrogating different people to solve the case. Based on the information from several people Johny and Bonny go to Natunpalli to interrogate Rokeya Mondal under disguise.

videos.title: If you can hear it, you can bear it!
videos.overview: Rokeya Mondal gets arrested for illegal alcohol business. Janardan starts talking to a number of close friends and aides of Rimi to find her. He retrieves a laptop with. At home, Bonny tries to retrieve an address from the laptop.

videos.title: Pride and Greed Bring Destruction
videos.overview: Janardan reaches Biswajit Dalal's house and confronts him. Meanwhile Bonny goes to Pramod Sen's residence, to play a game of chess. Back at home, Bonny deciphers a very crucial clue while listening to Rimi's voice note.
